visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) An orange and white tabby cat lies horizontally across a black, glossy entertainment console. The cat is flat on its belly, its head resting on the surface as it gazes toward the left of the frame. In the bottom foreground, a blurred laptop screen is visible, showing columns of text and small images, indicating a work-from-home setting. The background includes a large flat-screen TV and a dark, marbled wall. (2) The scene transitions slightly as the cat remains still, but five yellow dots appear in the center of the screen, followed by the text indicating a five-minute break. The cat continues to lie lazily on the shelf, its eyes partially closed, embodying a sense of total lethargy. The ambient lighting is bright and natural, reflecting off the shiny furniture. (3) A sudden digital zoom shifts the perspective to a close-up of the cat's face. The cat's eyes are now wide open and alert, looking directly into the camera lens. Bold yellow text appears at the top. The cat's whiskers are prominent against the dark background, and its ears are perked up, reacting to the shift in visual and auditory energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to create a humorous social media moment by personifying a pet cat as a strict 'boss' supervising its owner's work-from-home activities. By using the rhythmic pop song 'Work' and contrasting the cat's lazy posture with its sudden alert stare, it satirizes the feeling of being watched by a manager.
